mapper.select: SELECT u.*, d.name AS department_name FROM admin_users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id ORDER BY u.id ASC
SELECT aur.admin_user_id, r.id, r.name FROM admin_user_roles aur JOIN roles r ON r.id = aur.role_id ORDER BY r.id ASC
SELECT * FROM roles ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT role_id, permission_id FROM role_permissions ORDER BY permission_id ASC
SELECT * FROM departments ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

choose.when: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM permissions p JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN admin_user_roles aur ON aur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE aur.admin_user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort ASC, p.id ASC
choose.otherwise: SELECT * FROM permissions WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM config_items ORDER BY group_name ASC, sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments WHERE storage_type = #{storageType}
SELECT * FROM login_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM operation_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT `value` FROM config_items WHERE `key` = #{key} AND status = 1
